caption: The drawing features a single object, a sculpted eagle perched with its wings spread wide open. The eagle is predominantly colored in shades of yellow and brown, with detailed feather patterns that include darker brown lines and shading for texture. The eagle’s head is slightly turned to its left, with the beak open and colored a muted yellow-gray; the top of the head and around the eyes are also highlighted with a grayish tone. The talons of the eagle grip a smooth, spherical object that is bright yellow-orange, resting on a small square pedestal base, colored in similar brown and yellow tones as the eagle. The background is a plain, light beige color, and there are faint, irregularly shaped stains or marks in the corners of the paper. There are no other objects or elements present in the composition.
title: Metal Eagle
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
